messages:
alex: Quick question — PR #4123 touches both /infra/runtime and /models/serving. CODEOWNERS lists `eng-runtime` and `eng-ml`. Who can approve so this doesn't block the release? pinging @maria @sam @jen

maria: Can you paste the changed file list?

alex: Sure — changed files: 
- infra/runtime/deploy.yaml
- infra/runtime/router.go
- models/serving/handler.py
- models/serving/tests/test_handler.py

sam: I can sign off on the infra/runtime changes (router + deploy) but not the model handler. Need eng-ml review for models/serving.

jen: I can take the models review today. How big is the behavior change?

alex: It's mostly routing config + a small handler refactor (no model logic changes). added unit tests. PR description notes "config split for multi-tenant routing".

alex: Current CODEOWNERS snippet is: ```
/infra/runtime/* @eng-runtime
/models/serving/* @eng-ml
```

codeowners-bot: NOTE — If a PR modifies paths owned by multiple teams, approvals from each listed owner are required unless an override label is applied.

maria: Given that, options: 1) wait for both approvals (best), 2) add a temporary fallback reviewer from eng-ml, or 3) tag an on-call approver if this is urgent. Which do you prefer?

alex: We want to land before today's deploy window (5pm PT). I can ask for a quick look from @jen and add @sam as infra approver. If eng-ml can't review in time, can we use the emergency fallback?

sam: I'm ok as fallback for infra only. For models we need explicit eng-ml signoff; I don't want to merge model changes without that.

jen: I'll try to review by 4:30pm PT. If it's tiny, I'll approve. If I find anything blocking, I'll leave comments.

alex: Thanks — I'll update the PR: add reviewers @sam (infra) and @jen (models), mention canary deploy and rollback steps, and mark release window.

maria: Also add a short checklist in the PR description showing which owners signed off to make future audits easier.

alex: Will do. If anyone else wants to eyeball it, feel free. Otherwise I'll merge after both approvals or tag @maria for emergency merge if needed. :thumbsup:

jen: Sounds good — will ping here when done.

alex: Closing loop — thanks everyone!
